declarations.description:
WebDropzone - Renderer subclass of `DropzoneEngine`.

Inherits the file state, validation, upload pipeline, event emission,
reorder timers, persisted-state load/save, and overall-progress data
methods from `DropzoneEngine`. This class adds the DOM rendering layer
(popover, drag overlay, satellite mounting, click/keydown wiring) and
overrides the protected hooks declared on the base so core mutations
write back into the DOM.
declarations.name: WebDropzone

members.name: activate
members.description: Reconnect: restore the page-level wiring `deactivate()` stopped.

members.name: deactivate
members.description:
Disconnect: stop the page-level wiring; files, uploads and the popover
(open state + DOM) are kept for `activate()`.

members.name: htmlFor
members.description: Id of the `<web-dropzone>` store this satellite binds to (attribute `for`). Changing it re-binds. Not needed when the store mounts the satellite itself.

members.name: labels
members.description: This satellite's own UI strings — a partial `DropzoneLabels` (property, or a JSON attribute), merged per key over the bound store's `labels`, then the built-in English. Live.

members.name: customStyles
members.description: Extra CSS for this satellite's shadow root (raw CSS — NOT sanitized). Comes after the page-wide `window.components[tag].customStyles`, so it overrides it; `getCustomStylesCallback` wins over it.

members.name: getCustomStylesCallback
members.description: Returns extra CSS for this satellite's shadow root (raw CSS — NOT sanitized); wins over `customStyles`.

members.name: position
members.description: Where the chip sits: fixed to a viewport edge (right, left, top, bottom) or inline in the page flow.

members.name: drawer
members.description: `auto`: the chip is a button opening a slide-out drawer with the full file list; `off`: a non-interactive `role="status"` chip, no drawer.

members.name: drawerMode
members.description: How an edge drawer (`position` right / left / top / bottom) opens. `non-modal` (default): the page stays usable — Escape, a click outside or the phone Back gesture close it. `modal`: a backdrop, the page behind inert, Tab kept inside; Escape, a backdrop click or Back close it. A change while the drawer is open applies on the next open. The inline drop-down and the phone sheet are unaffected.

members.name: renderBodyCallback
members.description: Replace the whole chip body (`args`: `StatusSurfaceArgs`). Result: string = HTML, Node = mounted, `null` / `undefined` = the default body, `false` = the chip hidden. A custom body replaces the default file-info / progress slots.

members.name: renderFileInfoCallback
members.description: Replace the chip's file-info slot (default body only). `args.currentFile`, `currentFilePercent`, `currentFileStatus`. Result: string = HTML, Node = mounted, `null` / `undefined` = the default status glyph / loader, `false` = hidden.

members.name: renderProgressCallback
members.description: Replace the chip's progress slot (default body only): per-file and overall slices. Result: string = HTML, Node = mounted, `null` / `undefined` = the default percent, `false` = hidden.

members.name: shouldDefer
members.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

members.name: themeSource
members.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

members.name: motion
members.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

members.name: responsive
members.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on three axes — `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket), `container` (keyed by the component's own width: `narrow` / `medium` / `wide`, lines `--base-container-narrow` / `-medium`, 480 / 768) and `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width), applied in that order (a later axis wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

members.name: responsiveCallback
members.description: Instance computed responsive rule (core, SPEC §6.7): `(ctx) => partial config | null | undefined`, ctx `{ env, deviceClass, breakpoint, container, width, element, component, config }` (`config` = base; `width` = its own box). Runs after `responsive` (wins key by key); re-runs on environment flips, throttled viewport-width and own-width changes, rule and config changes. `null` ignores every page rule.

members.name: flush

members.name: motion
members.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). members.name: responsive
members.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on three axes — `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket), `container` (keyed by the component's own width: `narrow` / `medium` / `wide`, lines `--base-container-narrow` / `-medium`, 480 / 768) and `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width), applied in that order (a later axis wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

members.name: responsiveCallback
members.description: Instance computed responsive rule (core, SPEC §6.7): `(ctx) => partial config | null | undefined`, ctx `{ env, deviceClass, breakpoint, container, width, element, component, config }` (`config` = base; `width` = its own box). Runs after `responsive` (wins key by key); re-runs on environment flips, throttled viewport-width and own-width changes, rule and config changes. `null` ignores every page rule.

members.name: loadStateCallback

members.name: shouldDefer

members.name: themeSource

members.name: motion

members.name: responsive

members.name: responsiveCallback

events.name: file-add
events.description: A file entered the dropzone (one event per file). `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileAdd(detail)`.

events.name: file-remove

events.description: Coalesced "queue updated" tick, at most once per animation frame. `detail`: `{ changedIds, files }`. Twin: `onFilesChange(detail)`.

events.name: change
events.description: The selection changed (add / remove / clear). `detail`: `{ files }`. Twin: `onChange(detail)`.

events.name: file-reject

events.name: file-retry

events.name: file-upload
events.description: `uploadFileCallback` resolved for a file. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileUpload(detail)`.

events.name: file-delete

events.name: file-status-change

events.name: file-update

events.name: overlay-enter

events.name: overlay-leave
